SELECT customer_id, customer_code, customer_name, company_name, contact_person, phone, level, disabled_flag, remark, create_time FROM t_customer
deleted_flag = 0
AND ( INSTR(customer_code, #{queryForm.searchWord}) OR INSTR(customer_name, #{queryForm.searchWord}) OR INSTR(company_name, #{queryForm.searchWord}) )
AND disabled_flag = #{queryForm.disabledFlag}
ORDER BY customer_id DESC
